description: Test whether arabinose-cluster placement is specific to close AraM orthologs within the K00096 family
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
I=pd.read_csv("g1pdh_identity_to_araM.csv")
ctx=pd.read_csv("g1pdh_context.csv")[["gene","dpcrB"]]
I=I.merge(ctx,on="gene",how="left")
a=I[I.ara_context].pct_id_to_BSU28760; b=I[~I.ara_context].pct_id_to_BSU28760
U,p=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")
cles=U/(len(a)*len(b))
print("identity to AraM, ara-context vs not: median %.1f%% vs %.1f%%, Mann-Whitney U=%.0f p=%.3g, CLES=%.2f"%(a.median(),b.median(),U,p,cles))
# natural break
I["ortholog"]=I.pct_id_to_BSU28760>=35
ct=pd.crosstab(I.ortholog,I.ara_context); print("\nclose ortholog (>=35% id to AraM) x arabinose gene context"); print(ct)
orr,pf=fisher_exact(ct.values); print("Fisher OR=%.1f p=%.3g"%(orr,pf))
print("\nAmong close orthologs (n=%d): %d in ara context (%.0f%%), %d not"%(I.ortholog.sum(),int(I[I.ortholog].ara_context.sum()),100*I[I.ortholog].ara_context.mean(),int((~I[I.ortholog].ara_context).sum())))
print("Close orthologs NOT in ara context:")
print(I[I.ortholog & ~I.ara_context][["org","name","pct_id_to_BSU28760","dpcrB"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\npcrB distance among close orthologs: min %d  median %d"%(I[I.ortholog].dpcrB.min(),I[I.ortholog].dpcrB.median()))
I.to_csv("g1pdh_identity_context_joined.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.6))
ax.scatter(I[I.ara_context].pct_id_to_BSU28760, I[I.ara_context].dpcrB, s=34, color="#2f6f9f", label="arabinose gene context (n=%d)"%len(a))
ax.scatter(I[~I.ara_context].pct_id_to_BSU28760, I[~I.ara_context].dpcrB, s=34, color="#bbb", edgecolor="#777", label="no arabinose context (n=%d)"%len(b))
ax.axvline(35,ls="--",color="k",lw=1); ax.text(35.6,4600,"35% identity",fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(5,ls="--",color="red",lw=1); ax.text(26,60,"pcrB adjacency (<=5 genes): no locus qualifies",fontsize=8,color="red")
ax.set_yscale("symlog",linthresh=10)
ax.set_xlabel("global % amino-acid identity to B. subtilis AraM (BSU28760)")
ax.set_ylabel("gene-rank distance to nearest pcrB (K07094)")
ax.set_title("Firmicute K00096 loci: close AraM orthologs sit in arabinose gene clusters,\nnone sit beside pcrB",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower left"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
